verdict.rationale: cubic documents an Analytics API, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, no OpenAPI or equivalent spec is documented, and the probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file and the MCP server are related agent-facing features, not a downloadable API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
